api.installCommand: node -e "var p=require('path'),f=require('fs'),c=require('child_process'),d=process.cwd(),r='';for(var i=0;i<6&&!r;i++){if(f.existsSync(p.join(d,'apps','api','package.json'))&&f.existsSync(p.join(d,'packages','shared','package.json')))r=d;d=p.dirname(d)}if(!r)throw new Error('repo root not found');c.execSync('npm install',{cwd:r,stdio:'inherit'})"
